title: The Blinking Clock
teaser: When the power failed, every lock in Elm Court clicked open. The oven clock knows exactly how long it lasted.

booklet.briefing:
Elm Court's flat doors have magnetic locks. For fire safety they unlock automatically whenever the power fails.

At 6:15 pm on Tuesday the whole street lost power. When Mr. Fairley came home to Flat 4 at 8:40 pm, his cabinet of rare coins was empty. His front door had simply opened during the blackout.

The electricity company can only say power came back 'between 6:45 and 7:30'. That isn't good enough for Mr. Foxy. Something in Flat 4 kept better time.
rules: The door of Flat 4 was only unlocked while the power was off, so the burglary happened during the power cut.
Only the four people below were in the building that evening (the street door has a separate battery lock and a logged keypad).

setting.place: Elm Court, a small block of flats
setting.when: Tuesday evening, during a power cut

suspects.name: Hazel Brooke
suspects.description: Retired. Has complained about Mr. Fairley's late-night coin polishing (it squeaks).
suspects.motive: Her pension has been cut and she's two months behind on rent.
suspects.statement: When the lights went I lit some candles. Then at ten to seven I put the telly on for Brainbox, and I watched until half past. I didn't leave my flat.

suspects.name: Ian Castell
suspects.description: A student who was coming home with shopping when the lights went.
suspects.motive: Knows Mr. Fairley's collection is valuable; he helped carry the cabinet upstairs.
suspects.statement: I got stuck in the lift! It stopped between floors when the power went and I was in there for over an hour.

suspects.name: Jolene Sweeney
suspects.description: A nurse who works shifts. Was home that evening.
suspects.motive: Mr. Fairley reported her to the landlord for a noisy party.
suspects.statement: I was in bed resting before a night shift. The ward sister video-called me on my phone about a patient handover and we talked for ages.

suspects.name: Karl Dent
suspects.description: Lives in the basement flat and looks after the building.
suspects.motive: Has keys to everything, and knew the locks would open in a power cut.
suspects.statement: I went to the basement office to check the fuse board and rang the electricity company. I was on hold for ages.

evidence.title: The oven clock in Flat 4
evidence.body:
The digital clock on Mr. Fairley's oven is flashing 1:47.

From the oven manual: “After a power cut, the clock restarts from 0:00 and counts up, flashing, until you set the time.”

Nobody had touched it. The police photo is stamped 8:47 pm.

evidence.title: Lift company
evidence.body:
6:16 pm: emergency phone call from the Elm Court lift. Caller I. Castell, trapped between floors 1 and 2.

7:20 pm: engineer arrives. Power is on, but the lift has to be reset by hand. Passenger freed at 7:24 pm.

evidence.title: The corridor
evidence.body:
Drops of red candle wax on the second-floor corridor carpet, in a line from the door of Flat 4 to the door of Flat 2.

Red candles in a holder on Hazel Brooke's table, burned down by about an hour.

evidence.title: Jolene's video call
evidence.source: St. Anne's Hospital, ward sister and phone record
evidence.body:
Video call from Ward 6 to J. Sweeney's mobile: 6:24 pm to 7:02 pm.

Ward sister: “Jolene was sitting on her bed with a little battery lantern the whole time, with that big seagull poster behind her. She never got up. We went through every patient on the ward.”

questions.prompt: At what time did the power come back on? (24-hour clock.)
questions.explanation: The oven clock restarted from 0:00 when power returned and showed 1:47 at 8:47 pm. 8:47 minus 1 hour 47 minutes is 7:00 pm.

solution.explanation: When the lights went out, Hazel Brooke realised every door in the building had just unlocked. She took a red candle, crept down the corridor into Flat 4 and emptied Mr. Fairley's coin cabinet, dripping wax as she went. Then she invented an evening in front of the TV. She didn't know the oven clock in Flat 4 had quietly timed the power cut: the power came back at exactly 7:00, ten minutes after she 'switched on' her television.

chain.step: The oven clock showed 1:47 at 8:47 pm, so the power came back at 7:00 pm. The doors were unlocked from 6:15 to 7:00.
Hazel says she watched TV from 6:50. Impossible with no power.
Ian was in the lift from 6:16 to 7:24. Karl was on the basement phone from 6:22 to 7:03. Jolene was on a video call from her bed from 6:24 to 7:02.
Red candle wax runs from Flat 4 to Flat 2, and Hazel's red candles had burned for about an hour.

eliminations.name: Ian Castell
eliminations.why: Trapped in the lift from 6:16 until the engineer freed him at 7:24.

eliminations.name: Jolene Sweeney
eliminations.why: On a video call from 6:24 to 7:02, seen sitting on her bed the whole time. That leaves only the first nine minutes of the power cut, and the wax trail leads to Flat 2.

eliminations.name: Karl Dent
eliminations.why: On the fixed basement phone from 6:22 to 7:03, and the wax trail doesn't lead to him.
